description: Call this when the user asks what it costs to borrow USDT, USDC, BTC, ETH or a major alt on an exchange, which venue has the cheapest borrow, whether stablecoin borrow cost is spiking, or what the carry of a basis trade is on a venue (funding minus borrow). Returns the latest annualised rate per venue and asset, 30 days of hourly series for the stablecoins and majors, and the carry table. Recorded hourly by ByKaranteli (Binance and OKX today).
name: get_borrow_rates
title: Margin borrow rates per venue: the cost of leverage, hourly
